summary: Asyq Atu: flick your saqa to knock asyqs (knucklebones) out of a chalk ring against a ladder of bot opponents; each match is scored to the leaderboard.
description: A turn-based physics flicking game based on the traditional Kazakh game asyq atu. Canvas table with deterministic physics; the bot plans shots by simulating candidates. Saqas (shooter bones) are title items that change weight and look. A match reports games_played, matches_won and asyqs_won to quests that count them and submits its score to the asyq_weekly leaderboard (or the first plain score board).
